import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long gcd_xy = gcd(x, y);
        x /= gcd_xy;
        y /= gcd_xy;
        long numerator = 1000000000L;
        long denominator = 1L;
        if (y <= n) {
            System.out.println(x + "/" + y);
            return;
        }
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long val = (x * i) / y;
            if (denominator * Math.abs(x * i - val * y) < i * Math.abs(x * denominator - numerator * y)) {
                numerator = val;
                denominator = i;
            }
            val++;
            if (denominator * Math.abs(x * i - val * y) < i * Math.abs(x * denominator - numerator * y)) {
                numerator = val;
                denominator = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(numerator + "/" + denominator);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
